plugin.name: Linear
plugin.description: Linear issues, comments and project updates as activity items (webhook trigger and changed-since reads), users with email, and create-issue, comment and add-link actions over the GraphQL API
plugin.author: Landflow

nodes.name: linear
nodes.description: Read Linear issues, comments and project updates changed since a time as activity items, get an issue with its comments, list users with their email, create issues and comments and attach links
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}
nodes.toolDescription: Create a Linear issue, comment on an issue, attach a link to an issue, get one issue with its comments, list issues, comments or project updates changed since a time, or list workspace users with their email. It never deletes, archives or closes anything.

properties.name: since
properties.description: Records updated after this ISO time, or the cursor of an earlier item (an ISO time too). Empty: the last 24 hours.

properties.name: returnAll
properties.description: Whether to return all results or only up to a limit

properties.name: limit
properties.description: Max number of results to return (the oldest first for Changed Since)

values.name: teamKey
values.description: Issues Get Many Changed Since: only issues of the team with this key

values.name: customerNeeds
values.description: Whether to read Linear’s customer needs for the customer hint (turn off if the workspace has no Customers feature)

values.name: customerLabelPrefix
values.description: Used when an issue has no Linear customer needs: a label named <prefix><name> (customer:Acme) is about the customer <name> (customerHint). Empty: no label hints.

properties.name: issueId
properties.description: The issue to comment on: its identifier (ENG-123) or ID

properties.name: teamId
properties.description: The team that owns the issue. Pick one, or set a team ID with an expression

values.name: projectId
values.description: A project UUID of the team

values.name: stateId
values.description: A workflow state UUID of the team. Default: the team’s first status

properties.name: parentId
properties.description: Optional: the root comment of a thread to reply in

properties.name: url
properties.description: Attaching a URL already on the issue updates that attachment

properties.name: linkTitle
properties.description: Shown in Linear. Empty: the URL

options.name: OAuth2
options.description: Connect with Linear; needs the admin scope to register the webhook

properties.name: notice
properties.displayName: Publishing the workflow registers a webhook in Linear (webhookCreate) with a signing secret Landflow generates; unpublishing removes it. Registering needs a workspace admin's API key or an OAuth token with the admin scope, and a public HTTPS Landflow URL. Linear signs every delivery and Landflow verifies it with that secret.

properties.name: teamId
properties.description: Only events of this team. Empty: every public team, including teams created later

properties.name: resourceTypes
properties.description: The Linear resource types to subscribe the webhook to

values.name: customerLabelPrefix
values.description: Used when an issue has no Linear customer needs: a label named <prefix><name> (customer:Acme) is about the customer <name> (customerHint). Empty: no label hints.

values.name: tolerance
values.description: How far the payload's webhookTimestamp may be from now before the call is rejected as a replay (Linear recommends one minute)

credentialTypes.name: linearApi
credentialTypes.description: A personal API key (Linear Settings, Security & access). It is sent as is in the Authorization header, without Bearer. A key acts as you: creating webhooks for the Linear Trigger needs a workspace admin.

properties.name: baseUrl
properties.description: Change it only for a proxy or a test double. The GraphQL endpoint is <base URL>/graphql.

credentialTypes.name: linearOAuth2Api
credentialTypes.description: Sign in with Linear: create an OAuth2 application (Linear Settings, API), add the redirect URL shown below, then Connect. The default scopes are read plus issues:create and comments:create, which cover every node operation. The Linear Trigger registers its webhook through the API, which needs the admin scope: add it to Scopes (or register the webhook yourself and use a key).

properties.name: scope
properties.description: Comma-separated scopes asked for at Connect. read: all reads. issues:create: create issues and attach links. comments:create: comment. admin: needed only to register the Linear Trigger's webhook.

properties.name: baseUrl
properties.description: Change it only for a proxy or a test double. The GraphQL endpoint is <base URL>/graphql.
